definitions.label: Clip
definitions.blurb: The block's clip as an encoded stream: the input every mosh starts from.

definitions.label: Decode
definitions.blurb: The one decode boundary between the encoded stream and the GPU graph.

definitions.label: Seam mosh
definitions.blurb: Where one block bleeds into the next: the motion of the incoming clip smears over the picture already on screen.

params.label: Heal at GOPs
params.help: Off: the smear runs to the next picture block. On: the incoming clip's own keyframes reset the picture every GOP.

definitions.label: Reorder
definitions.blurb: Play a window of P-frames reversed, ping-ponged or strided: the motion runs backwards over the current picture.

params.label: Mode
params.help: Reverse plays the window backwards; ping-pong plays it forward then back; stride plays the even frames, then the odd.

params.label: From
params.help: First frame of the window, counted from the block's in-point.

params.label: To
params.help: Frame after the window. The window stays inside one GOP: a keyframe at its start stays put, and it stops at the next keyframe.

definitions.label: Plane desync
definitions.blurb: Shift one colour channel sideways, off-register from the other two.

params.label: Channel
params.help: Which channel shifts.

params.label: Shift X
params.help: Horizontal shift at full effect, in pixels of a 1080p frame so a recipe looks the same at any size. Clamped to the edge, not wrapped.

params.label: Shift Y
params.help: Vertical shift at full effect, in pixels of a 1080p frame.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How much of the shift applies. Drive it with an LFO to make the channel breathe.

params.label: Grain
params.help: Seeded per-frame grain on the shifted channel. Deterministic: the same frame always gets the same grain.

definitions.label: Feedback loop
definitions.blurb: Blend each frame over a zoomed, turned copy of the last output: trails that grow and drift.

params.label: Trail
params.help: How much of the last output survives each frame. 0 is off; near 1 the trail never fades.

params.label: Zoom
params.help: Scale of the fed-back copy. Below 1 the trail rushes outwards; above 1 it falls inwards.

params.label: Turn
params.help: Degrees the fed-back copy turns each frame.

definitions.label: Mix
definitions.blurb: Blend two frames by a mode (mix, add, screen, difference, multiply), optionally through a mask.

params.label: Mix
params.help: Share of B in the result. With a mask, the mask scales it per pixel.

params.label: Mode
params.help: How B combines with A: mix (cross-fade), add, screen, difference or multiply.

definitions.label: Delay
definitions.blurb: Last frame's input. The only way to wire a loop.

definitions.label: Output
definitions.blurb: What this block hands to the timeline: preview, export and freeze all read here.

definitions.label: Reroute
definitions.blurb: Tidies a picture wire: passes it on unchanged (double-click a wire to add one).

definitions.label: Reroute (stream)
definitions.blurb: Tidies an encoded wire before the Decode: passes the stream on unchanged.

definitions.label: Null
definitions.blurb: A named checkpoint: wire downstream from it, then add nodes before it without rewiring what follows.

definitions.label: Switch
definitions.blurb: Picks one of up to four pictures. Animate Input (an LFO, a Value) to hot-swap branches.

params.label: Input
params.help: Which input passes: 0 = A … 3 = D (rounded). An unwired input shows A.

definitions.label: Group input
definitions.blurb: Inside a container: its outputs are the container's inputs.

definitions.label: Group output
definitions.blurb: Inside a container: its inputs are the container's outputs.

definitions.label: Container
definitions.blurb: A look you can open: several nodes wired together, with a few knobs on its face.

definitions.label: Saturation
definitions.blurb: Pull colour out or push it in. 0 is grayscale.

params.label: Amount
params.help: 100 is the source unchanged. 0 is grayscale; above 100 pushes colour past the source.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Contrast
definitions.blurb: Push blacks and whites apart, or collapse them toward grey.

params.label: Amount
params.help: 100 is the source unchanged. 0 flattens to flat grey; above 100 pushes contrast past the source.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Brightness
definitions.blurb: Push the picture darker or brighter.

params.label: Level
params.help: 100 is unchanged; 0 is black, above 100 blows out toward white.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Hue rotate
definitions.blurb: Spin every colour around the wheel by a fixed angle.

params.label: Degrees
params.help: 0 leaves colour unchanged; 180 is the fullest rotation.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Invert
definitions.blurb: Flip every colour to its negative.

params.label: Amount
params.help: 100 is a full negative; partial values mix toward it.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Sepia
definitions.blurb: Tint the picture toward a warm monochrome.

params.label: Amount
params.help: 100 is a full sepia tint.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Posterize
definitions.blurb: Quantise every channel to a handful of levels: real banding, not a filter imitating it.

params.label: Levels
params.help: How many steps each channel is quantised to. Lower is harsher.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Channel isolation
definitions.blurb: Drop one or two colour channels outright. Real corruption of the decoded picture, not a colour filter.

params.label: Keep red
params.help: Off zeroes the red channel.

params.label: Keep green
params.help: Off zeroes the green channel.

params.label: Keep blue
params.help: Off zeroes the blue channel.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Chroma drift
definitions.blurb: Bias the blue-difference and red-difference colour values. Pixels stay in place. Animate Cb and Cr with an LFO; use Plane desync for spatial separation.

params.label: Cb shift
params.help: Blue-difference offset. Negative pulls toward yellow, positive toward blue.

params.label: Cr shift
params.help: Red-difference offset. Negative pulls toward green, positive toward red.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Mirror
definitions.blurb: Reflect one half of the frame onto the other, horizontal or vertical.

params.label: Vertical
params.help: Off mirrors left/right. On mirrors top/bottom.

params.label: Flip
params.help: Off: the first half (left/top) is the source. On: the second half (right/bottom) is the source.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Transform
definitions.blurb: Rotate, scale and offset the picture, and move the crop centre when zoomed in.

params.label: Turn
params.help: Quarter turns. Off the right angles, rotate leaves wedges by design.

params.label: Rotate
params.help: Fine rotation on top of the turn, around the frame centre.

params.label: Scale
params.help: 100 is the source unchanged.

params.label: Offset X
params.help: Shift the picture horizontally, in 1080p pixels.

params.label: Offset Y
params.help: Shift the picture vertically, in 1080p pixels.

params.label: Crop X
params.help: Where a zoomed-in crop is centred, left to right. 50 is centred.

params.label: Crop Y
params.help: Where a zoomed-in crop is centred, top to bottom. 50 is centred.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Row displacement
definitions.blurb: Shift horizontal bands sideways: rolling shutter, VHS tracking, screen tearing, or a wave melt, by curve.

params.label: Band
params.help: Height of each displaced band, in 1080p pixels.

params.label: Amount
params.help: Maximum horizontal shift, in 1080p pixels.

params.label: Curve
params.help: Linear is a rolling-shutter shear; sine a wave melt; random a tracking error; stepped a single tearing seam.

params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the sine and random curves drift over time. 0 holds still.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Pixel stretch
definitions.blurb: Smear one line of colour outward from a source row or column: a streak, not a shift.

params.label: Mode
params.help: Horizontal smears sideways from a column; vertical down from a row; wave lets the source column ripple over time.

params.label: Origin
params.help: Where the source line sits across the frame.

params.label: Reach
params.help: How far the smear reaches from the source line. 0 is off.

params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the source line ripples, in wave mode only.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Resolution crush
definitions.blurb: Draw at a lower internal resolution and scale back: blocky or soft, your choice.

params.label: Factor
params.help: How many times smaller the intermediate draw is. Higher is chunkier.

params.label: Smooth
params.help: Off: blocky nearest-neighbour. On: soft bilinear reconstruction.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Soft blur
definitions.blurb: A gentle box blur: softens raw, rough footage without touching timing.

params.label: Radius
params.help: Blur radius in 1080p pixels. 0 is off.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Salt & pepper
definitions.blurb: Sparse random black and white pixels: impulse noise, not grain.

params.label: Density
params.help: Chance any given pixel is hit. 0 is off.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Plane desync (temporal)
definitions.blurb: One or more channels lag behind, pulled from a frame N back: chromatic ghosting with real memory behind it.

params.label: Past red
params.help: On pulls red from the past frame instead of now.

params.label: Past green
params.help: On pulls green from the past frame instead of now.

params.label: Past blue
params.help: On pulls blue from the past frame instead of now.

params.label: Frames back
params.help: How many frames back to read. Deeper costs one working-size texture per frame of depth.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Field desync
definitions.blurb: Interlace against the past: alternating rows pulled from a frame N back, the rest held in the present.

params.label: Odd rows
params.help: Off: even rows pull from the past. On: odd rows do.

params.label: Frames back
params.help: How many frames back to read. Deeper costs one working-size texture per frame of depth.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Feedback trail
definitions.blurb: Blend toward a frame from N back, at a tunable strength: a smoothing trail, not noise.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How much of the past frame blends in. 0 is off.

params.label: Frames back
params.help: How many frames back to read. Deeper costs one working-size texture per frame of depth.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Chroma trail
definitions.blurb: Each colour channel lags by a different amount, so the trail separates into colour rather than grey.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How much of the lagged frames blends in. 0 is off.

params.label: Frames back
params.help: How many frames back to read. Deeper costs one working-size texture per frame of depth.

params.label: Spread
params.help: How unevenly the channels are weighted. 0 blends all three equally; 100 leans hardest on the furthest-back channel.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Drift trail
definitions.blurb: Blends toward a past frame that is nudged sideways, so the trail drifts rather than sitting still.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How much of the drifting past frame blends in. 0 is off.

params.label: Frames back
params.help: How many frames back to read. Deeper costs one working-size texture per frame of depth.

params.label: Drift X
params.help: Sideways nudge applied to the past frame before blending, in 1080p pixels.

params.label: Drift Y
params.help: Vertical nudge, in 1080p pixels.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Breath trail
definitions.blurb: A feedback trail whose depth rises and falls on a slow cycle, in step across every block that uses it.

params.label: Amount
params.help: Trail depth at the top of the breath. 0 is off.

params.label: Frames back
params.help: How many frames back to read. Deeper costs one working-size texture per frame of depth.

params.label: Period
params.help: Frames per full breath.

params.label: Floor
params.help: Depth at the bottom of the breath, as a share of amount. 0 fades the trail away completely each cycle.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Echo taps
definitions.blurb: Several past frames at falling weight: distinct ghosts rather than one smear.

params.label: Amount
params.help: Weight of the first echo. Each later one is quieter. 0 is off.

params.label: Taps
params.help: How many echoes. Each costs another read of a past frame.

params.label: Spacing
params.help: Frames between echoes. The furthest read is taps × spacing frames back.

params.label: Decay
params.help: How much of the previous echo's weight each further one keeps. Lower separates them harder.

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much of the effect is mixed in. 0 is the input untouched; drive it with an LFO to make the effect breathe.

definitions.label: Hold
definitions.blurb: Repeat frames. Their motion re-applies and the picture drifts: the classic bloom.

params.label: At
params.help: Where in the window to hold, as a percentage of it.

params.label: Span
params.help: How many frames are held. 1 freezes; more loops that many frames.

params.label: Times
params.help: How many times the held run repeats. More repeats, more drift.

params.label: Window from
params.help: Where in the block the effect begins. 0 is the first frame.

params.label: Window length
params.help: How much of the block it covers. 100 is all of it.

definitions.label: Stride
definitions.blurb: Keep every Nth frame. Motion arrives with gaps.

params.label: Every
params.help: Keep one frame out of this many. 2 keeps half, 4 a quarter.

params.label: Offset
params.help: Which frame of each group survives. Wraps at the group size.

params.label: Invert
params.help: Drop one in N instead of keeping one in N.

params.label: Window from
params.help: Where in the block the effect begins. 0 is the first frame.

params.label: Window length
params.help: How much of the block it covers. 100 is all of it.

definitions.label: Reverse
definitions.blurb: Play backwards. Motion applies the wrong way.

params.label: Chunk
params.help: Reverse in groups of this many frames. 0 reverses the whole window.

params.label: Window from
params.help: Where in the block the effect begins. 0 is the first frame.

params.label: Window length
params.help: How much of the block it covers. 100 is all of it.

definitions.label: Ping-pong
definitions.blurb: Forward, then backward. The run folds onto itself.

params.label: Laps
params.help: How many out-and-back passes over the window.

params.label: Pause
params.help: Frames held at each turnaround, where the motion reverses.

params.label: Double ends
params.help: Keep the first and last frame in the return pass as well.

params.label: Window from
params.help: Where in the block the effect begins. 0 is the first frame.

params.label: Window length
params.help: How much of the block it covers. 100 is all of it.

definitions.label: Stride slip
definitions.blurb: Motion updates once every N frames; the rest repeat the last real one. A stutter, not a cut: same length in, same length out.

params.label: Every
params.help: A new frame lands once out of this many. The rest repeat it.

params.label: Offset
params.help: Which frame of each group is the one that updates.

params.label: Window from
params.help: Where in the block the effect begins. 0 is the first frame.

params.label: Window length
params.help: How much of the block it covers. 100 is all of it.

definitions.label: Speed
definitions.blurb: Play the block faster or slower at any rate. Repeated frames re-apply their motion, so slowing down smears.

params.label: Rate
params.help: 100 is untouched. 50 is half speed and twice as long; 200 is double speed and half as long.

params.label: Window from
params.help: Where in the block the effect begins. 0 is the first frame.

params.label: Window length
params.help: How much of the block it covers. 100 is all of it.

definitions.label: Speed ramp
definitions.blurb: Speed that changes across the block: wind up, or grind to a halt.

params.label: Rate in
params.help: Rate at the start of the block. 100 is untouched.

params.label: Rate out
params.help: Rate at the end. Below rate in it slows across the block; above, it speeds up.

params.label: Window from
params.help: Where in the block the effect begins. 0 is the first frame.

params.label: Window length
params.help: How much of the block it covers. 100 is all of it.
